full_text:
Unnamed Titan 012 is a teal scarab-like Titan with an armored shell and six long legs. It is used for transport and tunneling. Its Amulet is in the possession of DeFoe. 

== History ==
DeFoe felt this beetle-like Titan was growing rebellious and idle so he summoned Unnamed Titan 011 to force it back to work. [TCG:SAS-140]

== Abilities ==
This Titan is used for transporting Seekers or Titans across desert terrain and tunneling. [TCG:SAS-140]
